descriptor: Three-night live music festival at The Boiler Room

voice.summary: Lowtide Sessions speaks in short, punchy bursts with a wink. It sells the night out: lineups, doors and set times first, with prices stated plainly and urgency kept real.
dos: Lead with the lineup and the doors time
Use short, punchy lines with hard stops
State ticket price and fees before checkout
donts: Avoid generic festival clichés like 'unforgettable vibes'
Never hide fees in the last step

taglines: Catch the tide at The Boiler Room
boilerplate: Lowtide Sessions is a three-night live music festival at The Boiler Room, featuring emerging artists and a ticketing flow with clear tiers, fees and printable passes.

microcopy.success: You're in. Your tickets are on their way.
